description: This script generates C++ code for OpenGL uniform type info tables, including functions to retrieve type metadata based on GL types. It defines a list of uniform types and functions to generate code snippets for each type.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that generates the C++ code file 'uniform_type_info_autogen.cpp' based on the defined uniform types.

methods.name: get_component_type
methods.description: Determines the component type (e.g., GL_FLOAT, GL_INT) for a given uniform type string.

methods.name: get_texture_type
methods.description: Determines the texture type (e.g., GL_TEXTURE_2D) for a given uniform type string.

methods.name: get_transposed_type
methods.description: Determines the transposed matrix type for a given uniform type string.

methods.name: get_bool_type
methods.description: Determines the boolean type for a given uniform type string.

methods.name: get_sampler_format
methods.description: Determines the sampler format (e.g., Shadow, Unsigned) for a given uniform type string.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_components
methods.description: Calculates the total number of components for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_component_size
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the component type.

methods.name: get_internal_size
methods.description: Calculates internal size in bytes for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_external_size
methods.description: Calculates external size in bytes for a uniform type.

methods.name: get_is_sampler
methods.description: Returns whether the uniform type is a sampler.

methods.name: get_is_matrix
methods.description: Returns whether the uniform type is a matrix.

methods.name: get_is_image
methods.description: Returns whether the uniform type is an image.

methods.name: get_glsl_asfloat
methods.description: Returns GLSL code snippet for converting bits to float based on component type.

methods.name: gen_type_info
methods.description: Generates a string with uniform type metadata for code generation.

methods.name: gen_type_index_case
methods.description: Generates a switch case string for type indexing.
